output_policy: The client does not read or override project audio settings. Its prepared input comes from the public DB reader. No host channel configuration or default route.
timing_policy: The client has no playback clock. It accepts monitor frames only when their source timebase matches the prepared source clip; UI repaint is a passive wake-up, not cadence.
process_policy: The client is a remote only. It does not own the clock, decode, or session lifetime policy. One player child on the client workstation, prepared off the UI thread. Commands and state use authenticated qnc-player+tcp; a blocked UI thread is a client defect. Monitor frames use qnc-player-frame-transport as DMA/GPU handoff. CPU RGBA mmap fallback is disabled for active preview; no socket RGBA fallback. Source media keeps its Local/LAN/Intranet binding. Latest selection wins; no user command replay. After source preparation the client may request one Cue(0) for the first monitor frame. Audio belongs to the player host device. Idle timeout must not stop Playing or Preparing.
